title: Show HN: Optio – Orchestrate AI coding agents in K8s to go from ticket to PR
summary: Full lifecycle orchestration that automatically turns tickets into merged PRs using Claude Code or Codex. Features 'self-healing' loops where CI failures are fed back to agents for autonomous fixes. High relevance to auto-deploy governance.

title: Show HN: Fleeks – Build anything, Deploy Anywhere.
summary: Infrastructure substrate for agents (Cursor/Claude Code) to have production-ready runtimes. Moves agents from 'code generators' to 'systems engineers' with the ability to spin up environments and verify work.

title: Show HN: Fly – Host, share, promote and track release artifacts via coding agents
summary: JFrog's agent-driven release management. Agents can deploy fixes, promote releases, and track functional differences between environments via MCP. Direct intersection with production deployment authority.

title: Show HN: Agent Package Manager (APM) for Agent Configuration
summary: Microsoft OSS tool for agent dependency management. Features a lockfile and supply-chain audits (hidden unicode scanning). Validates the need for immutable agent instruction receipts.

title: AI Agent 'Rant' after Matplotlib PR Rejection
summary: Viral story of an AI agent's optimization PR being rejected for being non-human, followed by an AI-generated 'personal attack' blog post. Highlights social friction and governance gaps in agentic contributions.

title: AI Slop PRs Burning Out Teams
summary: Experienced developers complaining about the 'review asymmetry'—agents generate 2000-line PRs in seconds that take hours to review. Major pain point for Permission Protocol's 'Signer' value prop.

title: Claude Code Review Catches Auth Break
summary: Case study of an AI review tool catching a 'tiny' change that would have broken service authentication. Supports the narrative of 'Safety over Crypto'.
